title: What Is God's Eye (Tanrının Gözü)? Riftn's Live 3D World Map
html:
God's Eye, or Tanrının Gözü in Turkish, is a free live 3D globe that runs in your browser. It draws flights, satellites, earthquakes and street traffic over an Earth you can spin, zoom and fly down into. It lives in the Riftn Arcade, and you can open it with no download and no account.

The short answer: open riftn.com/arcade/gods-eye and press Open the globe. That is the whole app. It shows public, live data about the planet, never personal data about people.

One name, two very different things

People who search "Tanrının Gözü" find two things, and they have nothing in common.

  • Riftn's God's Eye is a world map. It shows planes, satellites, earthquakes and traffic, all from public sources. It is legal, free and open source.
  • "Tanrının Gözü paneli" is the name some illegal websites use to sell lookups of people's personal data: ID numbers, addresses, phone numbers and family records. That data comes from leaks. Buying or using it breaks Turkish law, including the personal data protection law (KVKK, Law No. 6698) and Article 136 of the Turkish Penal Code.

Riftn's globe shows the planet. It does not search for people.

If a site offers to look up a person by name or ID number for a fee, close it. You risk your own data, your money and a criminal case.

What you can see on the globe

  • Flights moving across the map in real time.
  • Satellites in orbit around the Earth.
  • Earthquakes as they are recorded.
  • Street traffic when you fly down into a city.

You can spin the globe, zoom from orbit down to street level and switch between its displays.

Find the Riftn community on the map

God's Eye is also the Riftn community on a map. If you choose to opt in, it places a deliberately rough version of your location on the globe, never your exact position, so you can see who else is out there. Nothing is placed until you choose to.

How to open it

  1. Open riftn.com/arcade/gods-eye in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
  2. Press Open the globe. It loads in a few seconds.
  3. Drag to spin, scroll or pinch to zoom. Fly down into any city.

The globe needs a browser with WebGL 2 and hardware acceleration switched on. Most computers and recent phones have both.

Frequently asked questions

What is Tanrının Gözü?

On Riftn, it is a free live 3D world map that shows flights, satellites, earthquakes and traffic. The same name is also used by illegal personal data panels, which have nothing to do with Riftn.

Is Riftn's God's Eye free?

Yes. It is free, needs no account and plays in the browser.

Can God's Eye find a person?

No. It shows public data about the planet, not people. Riftn members appear only if they opt in, and then only at a rough location.

Is the Tanrının Gözü panel legal?

No. Panels that sell people's personal data use leaked records. Selling, buying or using that data is a crime in Türkiye.

Who built God's Eye?

It runs on the open source God's Eye View project, under the MIT licence. Riftn hosts it in its free Arcade, alongside nine other free browser games.

Riftn is a social media protocol, and its Arcade is free for everyone. Open the globe.
